# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** fourteen  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Charlotta the Fourth (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.People P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta has a freckled face paired with a snubbed nose and a wide mouth. She is known for her wide smiles and wears a blue bow.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted handmaiden who shows sincere concern for the well-being of her mistress. She harbors a strong dislike for [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) and experiences intense homesickness.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)_

## History

Charlotta the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) was a fourteen-year-old girl who lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) as a maid for Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). She often hosted visiting guests alongside her employer, serving tea, picking strawberries, and sharing her anxieties about Miss Lavendar's melancholy behavior. When [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) returned to rekindle his romance with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), Charlotta helped [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepare for his arrival and anxiously awaited the outcome in the kitchen until she witnessed their joyful reconciliation. She subsequently assisted in the hectic preparations for Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Stephen's garden wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +300 more_

>

> "I peeked from the kitchen window . . . and he’s awful handsome . . . and just the right age for Miss Lavendar. And oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, do you think it would be much harm to listen at the door?"
>

## Relationships

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana.md)

Charlotta and [Diana](../character/diana.md) share a friendly acquaintance centered around visits to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Charlotta warmly welcomes [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) when they visit the lodge for tea, and they later work alongside each other to help prepare the stone house for Miss Lavendar's wedding. [Diana](../character/diana.md) continues to visit the lodge where Charlotta serves, remaining on good terms as they air out the house together.

- Friend of — welcomes her warmly at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as the young maid at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for her eccentric employer, Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), who bestows the traditional name of "Charlotta the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md)" on her. Beyond performing household duties and helping host guests for garden teas, Charlotta is deeply devoted to Miss Lavendar's well-being. She voices genuine concern over Miss Lavendar's melancholy moods to their friends, actively worrying about her happiness until Miss Lavendar's eventual marriage and departure.

- Serves under — employer  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +4 more</sub>
